title: Recommended Push Defaults per ThingsBoard Subscription Plan — tb_plan_defaults
text: Wraps per-device transport rate limits documented https://thingsboard.io/docs/paas/eu/subscriptions/ parameters package's push functions take. Pass result tb_push_station_telemetry() via mode, chunk_size throttle_seconds stay plan's "Telemetry Transport messages/data points (Device)" thresholds. Across paid PaaS tiers per-device sustained limits identical (2 000 telemetry data points per minute, 15 000 per hour), thing changes aggressive burst platform tolerates drops request. Free additionally rejects bulk array form device telemetry endpoint, default mode = "single". Self-hosted ThingsBoard CE per-tenant rate limit default, hence much larger chunk size zero throttle.

Default "Datum". value_col name numeric value column. Default "Messwert" (set "Tagesmittelwert" surface water data). key_col name column whose values become telemetry keys. Default "Parameter".
